Title: [LSJ] question on when bleed reduction is applied

Messages.Author: Doug
Messages.Body:
We had a situation come up in a game yesterday that caused some
disagreement. A vampire with a base bleed of 1 was bleeding with an
inferior Govern the Unaligned. The person being bled reduced the
bleed using Telepathic Counter at AUS and Folderol. The bleeding
vampire then pumped the bleed with a Bonding, giving an additional +1
bleed (4 bleed without the reduction applied).

The disagreement arose as to when the bleed reduction is applied. Is
the bleed reduction applied as it is played?

Or does the bleed reduction only count when you arrive at the
resolution of the bleed (i.e when determining how much pool to burn
for a sucessful bleed)?

The important factor here is that the Methuselah being bled held an
Archon Investigation in hand...was the bleeding vampire a legal target
for AI prior to the bleed resolving?

Thanks
Doug

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:

>We had a situation come up in a game yesterday that caused some

>inferior Govern the Unaligned. The person being bled reduced the
>bleed using Telepathic Counter at AUS and Folderol. The bleeding
>vampire then pumped the bleed with a Bonding, giving an additional +1
>bleed (4 bleed without the reduction applied).
>
>The disagreement arose as to when the bleed reduction is applied. Is
>the bleed reduction applied as it is played?

The running total can go negative. e.g. bleed for 1, reduce for 2,
running total -1, Threats at superior running total 1.

>The important factor here is that the Methuselah being bled held an
>Archon Investigation in hand...was the bleeding vampire a legal target
>for AI prior to the bleed resolving?

The bleed is reduced when the card resolves.
